message.content:
Egg albumin falls in HTS 3502. Subheading 3502.11 covers dried egg albumin, and 3502.19 covers other egg albumin. The product is a spray-dried powder, so it is dried egg albumin under 3502.11. It is enzymatically hydrolyzed, but there is no indication it falls outside 3502 as a protein hydrolysate (3504). CBP rulings on hydrolyzed egg white protein powder have classified it in 3502.11 as egg albumin, which fits the "commercially known as egg albumen" description.

3502.11 splits into 3502.11.00 and its statistical suffixes. 3502.11.00 is "Egg albumin: Dried," with the statistical suffixes 3502.11.0010 (egg albumin, dried, unfit for human consumption) and 3502.11.0090 (other). The product is for food use, so I use 3502.11.0090.
